evidence.name: MainCameraDirectorUpdate

function_ir.summary: Per-frame update of the main camera director. Tracks player-vehicle changes, runs a one-time camera setup guard, negates a triple-field offset vector, then either short-circuits (clear skip flag) or picks the camera action from the AI random state machine versus keyboard input, requests the mode change, and applies camera mode-change callbacks and vehicle-position/velocity tracking on the camera controller object.

operations.description: Retarget the camera to the current player vehicle when the player changes.
Run a short setup computation over the director object.
First-time initialization guard: when the one-time flag is unset the camera is configured once.
Set the one-time initialization flag.
Configure the prior camera entity (stored in the previous-camera field) on first setup.
Read a triple of float fields out into local scratch values.
Negate each component of the triple-field vector in place.
Conditional branch helper invoked with a zero flag value.
Skip flag check: if the per-frame skip flag is set the update short-circuits after clearing it.
Clear the per-frame skip flag on the short-circuit path.
Reset the camera action state counter for the frame.
Select the camera input source from the AI-mode flag: random state machine when set, keyboard otherwise.
AI branch: drive camera selection through the random state machine with timer and trigger.
Input branch: map the keyboard action to a camera command.
Request a camera mode change on the director.
When the resulting camera action requests a mode transition, run the per-vehicle and camera callbacks.
On mode transition, iterate the global vehicle array calling a per-vehicle sub-routine on each slot base.
Invoke the camera controller's mode-change virtual (vtable slot +16) on the current camera entity.
Read the resulting camera state through the controller's state virtual (vtable slot +12).
Proceed with position/velocity tracking only while the global camera-tracking object is present.
Fetch six values (two triples) through a delegation helper for the tracking math.
Negate the offset vector again after the delegation.
Branch on the mode-transition result to decide between the particle path and the velocity-tracking path.
Mode-transition path: dispatch a position/velocity update virtual (vtable slot +28) on the tracking object.
When the global particle-add flag is set, return the result of adding a particle at the tracked position.
Velocity-tracking path: compare the current camera entity against the stored previous camera entity.
Unchanged camera: source the vehicle position from the global vehicle-track slot offset.
Changed camera: fetch the entity position through the controller's position virtual (vtable slot +24) and use its float vector.
Clamp the velocity magnitude against the speed/velocity limit globals, scaled by a unit-conversion constant unless the conversion-disable flag is set.
Obtain the current speed through the virtual dispatch helper on the director.
Feed the combined speed value into a short computation helper.
Dispatch the final position/velocity update virtual (vtable slot +32) on the tracking object with the offset vector and speed.
